description: An AI office team for UAE/Saudi-style spreadsheet work: attach a file, describe the job, and agents plan it, write the automation, QA it against an independent oracle (including Arabic digit/name key variants), and ask you to approve one code hash before writing the filled file. Analysis mode ranks what to automate from Zetaris workforce data; synthetic hours are demo instrumentation, not customer ROI.

run.setup: Windows: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File setup.ps1 (virtual environment, dependencies, .env, shortcut); other platforms and default mode: docs/SETUP.md
run.desktop_app: Windows: the AgentOffice shortcut that setup.ps1 creates (AgentOffice.pyw): no terminal, no browser tab, Ctrl+Shift+Space opens the island
run.sample_mode: docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 -e SAMPLE_MODE=true oah-submission, then open http://localhost:8000
run.default_mode: python run.py with Zetaris and Meterless Nightshift configured in .env (see README)

zetaris.role: Data layer for everything the agents read in default mode.
zetaris.integration: Lightning REST tables in a local Zetaris 2.4.3: five synthetic workforce tables and upload_cells (every uploaded spreadsheet, one row per cell). Agents write SQL against workforce.<table>, rewritten to read the REST table; the Data Profiler profiles uploads and the Retriever runs lookup SQL on Zetaris.

power_rule.provider: Meterless Nightshift as the primary model provider for every agent

engines_implemented.role: Shared state every stage reads and writes; its conflict records are the Conflict Critic's evidence; task mode records spreadsheets and automations.
Cross-run memory: human approval decisions and QA lessons; an approved automation runs again without asking, a rejected one is not re-proposed.

nvidia.how: Served through Meterless Nightshift (route meterless/deep), hosted, no local GPU; powers routing, planning, SQL, code writing and revision, test design, review, critique and decision memos.

data: Synthetic only (scripts/generate_workforce_data.py, scripts/generate_task_samples.py); example.com / example.org emails.
